choices.label: Repitch causes a pitch variation, similar to the behavior of old tape delay units.
Fade creates a crossfade between the old and new delay times. This sounds similar to time stretching if the delay time is changed gradually.
Jump immediately changes to the new delay time (which can cause audible artifacts).
